subject: Competitive bake-off recap & next steps - Redwood vs. incumbents
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@omniva.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood vs incumbents - key pain, decision criteria, next steps

Alex - thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so the whole team is aligned and we have a clear set of follow-ups. Please reply if anything below isn't accurate.

Summary of your goals / pain points
- Primary: reduce inference latency on customer-facing chat (p95 target) while also lowering per-token cost. Current vendor averages ~220ms p95 and $0.035 / 1k tokens.
- Security/compliance: must support private deployment (VPC or on-prem) and provide SOC 2 evidence.
- Reliability: predictable capacity during promotions (burst handling) and automated fallbacks if a model variant is degraded.
- Observability: token-level cost/latency breakdowns and simple tracing for support teams.

Decision criteria you highlighted
1) Latency: p95 < 120ms for 512-token requests (priority)
2) Unit economics: projected blended cost < $0.02 / 1k tokens at 50M tokens/month
3) Deployment flexibility: Private (VPC) option required; on-prem preferred for PHI workflows
4) Security: SOC 2 + KMS/HSM support
5) Rollout controls: canary/A-B and automatic fallback policies

Competitive context (what we heard)
- You plan to run a 2-3 vendor bake-off that includes the incumbent, Redwood, and one managed cloud provider. Your tech team will run standardized benchmarks and production-like traffic.

Open questions we agreed to answer / tests to run
- Redwood to provide a competitive matrix comparing the three vendors on latency/cost/security/features (attached).
- Rishi to run a latency benchmark with your sample trace (we agreed on a 5k query set) and publish p50/p95/p99 + token costs.
- Provide a cost projection model for 50M tokens/month with batching/caching knobs enabled.
- Share SOC 2 summary and KMS integration notes; Marissa will follow up with security artifacts.
- Confirm procurement path & NDA needs (you mentioned an internal legal review).

Attachments (in this thread)
- redwood-bakeoff-matrix.xlsx (competitive feature / perf matrix)
- mutual-action-plan.pdf (high-level timeline & owners)

Proposed next steps
1) Redwood: run latency benchmark (Rishi) and deliver results by EOD Wed 2026-10-07.
2) Omniva: share sample trace + contact for SSO/procurement (Priya or Michael).
3) Quick sync to review results: propose Tue 2026-10-12 10:00 AM PT - 30m.

If that looks right I'll kick off the tests later today and loop in Marissa for the security artifacts.

Thanks again - appreciate the candid feedback today.

Best,
Aditya Rao

- NDA / procurement: copying Marissa (legal/security) and Priya. Marissa - can you share the SOC 2 summary and a short mutual NDA template? We can also send a DocuSign link; I've included a HubSpot record + DocuSign link in the metadata above.
